tagline: Free game mods, modding tools and SolClient for Furcadia. Everything I make, all in one place.
homeTitle: Loveless Gaming: free game mods, modding tools and SolClient for Furcadia
description: Free game mods, modding tools and fixes from Loveless Gaming, plus SolClient, a modern add-on for the Furcadia client.
about: Loveless Gaming is my home base on the web. My game mods, modding tools and SolClient for Furcadia all start here, so you don't have to chase them across Nexus, GitHub and Discord.

Mods are hosted where the modding community already lives, and the tools and source code are on GitHub. Books (for Amazon) and articles (on Medium) are on the way, written under the pen name Mordren Illantru. This site links to all of it and stays up to date.

support.intro: Everything I make is free: SolClient, the mod tools and fixes, the setups and guides. If it's saved you time or made your game better and you'd like to chip in, it goes straight back into building more of it. Thank you!

platforms.name: Ko-fi
platforms.note: One-time tips or a small monthly amount, no account needed.

platforms.name: Patreon
platforms.note: Monthly support, with early looks at what I'm working on.

platforms.name: GitHub Sponsors
platforms.note: For the open-source mod tools on GitHub.

promises: Donations are optional. SolClient and everything else here stay free, with no paid features.
Supporting doesn't buy anything inside Furcadia or any other game.
Not into donating? A share, a bug report, or a Furnarchy module you'd like ported helps just as much.
